title: hermes-meta-rubric policy spec v1
description: Declarative policy that synthesizes hermes-rubric scoring behavior per (intent, context, target_type). Replaces the hardcoded source-class cap (score.py:106-108) and window-bytes default (cli.py:48). Opinionated v1, replaceable.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this policy entry (e.g. preprint-paper-v1).

policy_version.description: Semver-like tag for the policy. Bumps when caps or weights change.

target_type_match.description: List of target_type labels this policy applies to (e.g. preprint-paper, repo, tool, document). First-match-wins in the registry.

source_class_caps.description: Per-source-class score ceiling. The original tool hardcodes a cap of 6 when ALL citations are readme/doc (self-marketing). For prose targets like papers, README/doc IS the ground truth and must NOT be capped at 6. A null value means no cap.

window_bytes.description: Adaptive --target-window-bytes. For preprint papers (typically 30k-80k chars) the default 8000 silently truncates body evidence and forces hedge=true on later sections. Recommend 80000 for papers, 8000 for repos.

dim_weight_strategy.description: How dimension weights are interpreted. 'preserve' = use synthesizer-assigned weights as-is. 'flatten' = all dims weight=1. 'amplify-load-bearing' = boost dims tagged load_bearing=true by +1.

prompt_template_id.description: Which synthesis prompt variant to use. 'default' = stock hermes-rubric. 'prose-target' = treats README/doc/prose as ground truth, not self-marketing.

no_evidence_floor.description: Score ceiling when evidence_found=false. Original is 3. Some targets (gate cards, abstracts) may justify a higher floor.

hedge_band.description: Score range a hedged dim is clamped into. Original is [3,7].

rationale.description: One-paragraph human-readable justification. Why these caps + window for this target_type. Audit trail.

fallback_policy_id.description: Policy to fall through to if this one cannot be applied (e.g. window too small for target). Terminates at policy_id='default'.

intent_debias.description: Pass-through to hermes-rubric --intent-debias. Strips valence-loaded framing from intent.

batch.description: Pass-through to hermes-rubric --batch. Single LLM call per stage; falls back per-dim.

examples.rationale: For preprint papers the ground truth is the prose itself. The hardcoded cap-at-6 for README/doc citations is a software-repo heuristic that mis-scores papers. Window expanded to 80k bytes so a 30-80k paper is not silently truncated.
For repos the original cap-at-6 on README/doc is correct: README is self-marketing and code/test is ground truth. Default window of 8000 bytes preserves v0.1.x behavior.
Catch-all. Mirrors original hermes-rubric behavior exactly.
